title: Concept: conda environment mixes pip installs into the solver's tree
description: environment.yml declares a `pip` entry in the conda dependency list, which lets pip install outside the solver, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: pip writes packages the conda solver did not resolve, so the environment has two sources of truth and the pinned file no longer describes it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through environment.yml (conda).
risk: pip writes packages the conda solver did not resolve, so the environment has two sources of truth and the pinned file no longer describes it.
